tools.name: get_hospital
tools.description: Full details for one hospital: Chinese name, address in English and Chinese, coordinates and map links, international department, how foreign patients get in, official website, source links and the ChinaCareMap guide page.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Official and published prices for foreign patients in China, each with its source page: doctor_visit (consultation fees by doctor rank at public hospitals, special-needs clinics), dental_implants (national price limits, implant and crown prices), health_checkup (package prices at six hospitals).

tools.name: get_travel_guide
tools.description: Curated answers for one fixed topic of a medical trip to China. tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Free-text search across all of ChinaCareMap's sourced FAQ answers about medical treatment in China. Use this for a specific question in the user's own words, or when it is unclear which get_travel_guide topic applies. Returns up to 5 best-matching questions with answers and page links. tools.description: List every in-depth guide on chinacaremap.com with its id, title, one-line summary and link: overview of medical tourism in China, hospital list, doctor visit costs, dental implants, dental tourism, health check-ups, Shenzhen, how hospitals are chosen, and about the service.
